scientific_integrity: One finite exhaustive classification independently checked against a structural dihedral criterion; direct proofs establish the shortest counterexample and lower-length minimality. The complete 48-word census is obtained by a reproducible exhaustive verifier, not by an unjustified extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only the minimum length eight is classified. We do not assert a formula for all even lengths or independent verification, and equivalent counterexamples in unindexed sources may exist.
title: Shortest counterexamples to ternary dihedral shuffle-square universality
